item.title: Oh Se-hoon: “Deep responsibility as sitting mayor... suspending all campaign activities” (오세훈 “현직 시장으로 깊은 책임감…모든 선거운동 중단”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, visited the site of the Seosomun Overpass collapse on the 26th and said, “Although my duties are currently suspended, as the sitting mayor, I feel a deep sense of responsibility.” (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 26일 서소문고가차도 붕괴 사고 현장을 찾아 “현재로서는 직무가 정지돼 있지만 현직 시장으로서 정말 깊은 책임감 느낀다”고 말했다.)

After receiving a briefing from the Seoul Fire and Disaster Headquarters and other agencies at the accident site, Candidate Oh stated, “A tragic accident has occurred. An accident that truly should never have happened. From this moment onward, I will temporarily suspend all election campaign activities.” He added, “I have no words to say to the bereaved families of the three deceased individuals. I feel a profound sense of responsibility and offer my deepest condolences to the families.” Candidate Oh learned of the accident while traveling for a campaign event and arrived at the site around 4 p.m., later returning at 5:37 p.m. to deliver this statement. (오 후보는 이날 사고 현장에서 서울소방재난본부 등으로부터 브리핑을 들은 뒤 “안타까운 사고가 있었다. 참으로 있어서는 안 되는 사고가 있었다”며 “이 시간 이후에 모든 선거 운동을 잠정적으로 중단토록 하겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “세 분의 고인의 유가족분들께는 뭐라 드릴 말씀이 없다”며 “참으로 깊은 책임감을 느끼고 유가족분들께 깊은 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다. 오 후보는 유세를 위해 이동하던 중 사고 소식을 듣고 오후 4시께 사고 현장에 도착했고, 이후 5시37분께 다시 현장을 찾아 이런 입장을 밝혔다.)

Candidate Oh said, “The most important thing is to prevent further accidents, so I have urged the construction personnel and relevant agencies to focus on that. I have also instructed public officials to spare no support for the bereaved families and the injured from this point on.” (오 후보는 “제일 중요한 것은 추가 사고가 없어야 하기 때문에 그 부분에 대해서 공사 관계자분들과 관계 기관에 당부의 말씀을 드렸다”며 “이 시간 이후에 유가족분들과 부상자분들에게 필요한 모든 지원을 아끼지 않도록 공무원에게 요청드렸다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, at around 2:33 p.m. on the same day, the Seosomun Overpass, which had been undergoing demolition after receiving a D grade (critical condition) in a precision safety inspection due to aging, collapsed. The structure fell onto the ground road, resulting in three fatalities as of 6 p.m., with rescue operations ongoing. (앞서 이날 오후 2시33분께 노후화로 정밀안전진단 디(D)등급 판정을 받고 철거 공사 중이던 서소문 고가차도가 무너지는 사고가 발생했다. 구조물이 지상 도로를 덮치면서 오후 6시 현재 3명이 사망했고, 구조 작업이 진행 중이다.)

Reporter Jang Narae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Unrepentant Israel… "Completely Denies Detention and Assault of Korean Activists Heading to Gaza" (반성 없는 이스라엘…“가자행 한국 활동가 구금·폭행 전면 부인”)
item.description:
After Korean activists aboard an aid flotilla heading to the Gaza Strip in Palestine stated they were assaulted by the Israeli military, the Israeli Embassy on the 26th issued a statement saying it "completely denies the detention and abuse." This response from Israeli authorities came three days after the Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned the charge d'affaires of the Israeli Embassy in South Korea on the 23rd, urging a thorough investigation. (팔레스타인 가자지구로 향하던 구호 선단에 탑승한 한국인 활동가들이 이스라엘군에 폭행당했다고 밝힌 데 대해 이스라엘 대사관이 26일 “구금과 학대를 전면 부인한다”는 입장을 내놨다. 외교부가 지난 23일 주한 이스라엘 대사관 대사대리를 초치해 “철저한 조사를 촉구”한 지 사흘 만에 이스라엘 당국이 내놓은 반응이다.)

The Israeli Embassy in Seoul released a statement on the same day, asserting, "Regarding the two Korean nationals, contrary to the claims they made after returning home, and as confirmed by the Korean government, they were not detained," adding that it "raises questions about the credibility of their claims of being assaulted." (주한이스라엘대사관은 이날 성명을 내고 “두 명의 한국 국민과 관련하여, 이들이 귀국 후 제기한 주장과 달리, 그리고 한국 정부도 확인한 바와 같이, 이들은 구금된 사실이 없다”면서 “이들이 폭행당했다는 주장의 신빙성에 의문을 더한다”고 주장했다.)

The Israeli Embassy also "completely denied" the activists' claims of physical abuse. (이스라엘대사관은 활동가들이 신체적 학대를 당했다고 밝힌 데 대해서도 “전면 부인”했다.)

In the statement, the Embassy said, "Various serious allegations, including claims of physical abuse (against the Gaza aid flotilla passengers), have been leveled against Israel," and "Israel completely denies these allegations." It also characterized the activists' claims as "part of an attempt to systematically wage a defamation campaign against Israel" and "a deliberate attempt to damage the friendly relations between Korea and Israel." The statement made no mention of the international controversy sparked by the release of a video showing Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir allegedly abusing and mocking activists on the aid flotilla heading to Gaza. (대사관은 성명에서 “(가자지구 구호선단 탑승자들에 대한) 신체적 학대 주장을 포함한 다양하고 심각한 의혹이 이스라엘을 향해 제기됐다”면서 “이스라엘은 이러한 주장들을 전면 부인”한다고 밝혔다. 활동가들의 주장에 대해서는 “이스라엘에 대한 비방 캠페인을 조직적으로 전개하려는 시도의 일환” “한-이스라엘 간 우호적 관계를 의도적으로 훼손하려는 시도”라고 주장하기도 했다. 이타마르 벤그비르 이스라엘 국가안보장관이 가자지구로 향하던 구호선단 활동가들을 학대·조롱하는 영상이 공개돼 국제적으로 논란이 인 것에 대해서는 전혀 언급하지 않았다.)

Earlier, activists Kim Ah-hyun (activity name: Haecho) and Kim Dong-hyun, who were aboard the Gaza-bound flotilla, were captured by the Israeli military and returned to Korea on the 22nd. After returning, Kim Ah-hyun met with reporters at the airport and said, "I was hit in the face several times (by the Israeli military), so my left ear is not functioning well." (앞서 가자지구행 선단에 탑승했던 활동가 김아현(활동명 해초)씨와 김동현씨는 이스라엘군에 나포됐다가 지난 22일 귀국했다. 김아현씨는 귀국 후 공항에서 기자들과 만나 “(이스라엘군에) 얼굴을 여러 차례 맞아 사실 왼쪽 귀가 잘 안 들리는 상태”라고 말했다.)

Yoo Byung-seok, Director of the Consular Safety Bureau at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, summoned Barak Shine, the charge d'affaires of the Israeli Embassy in South Korea, on the 23rd. In response, a Foreign Ministry official said on the 26th, "We conveyed a serious message to the Israeli charge d'affaires on the 23rd and urged a thorough investigation," adding that "if the inhumane treatment is confirmed, there must be corresponding measures." (유병석 외교부 영사안전국장은 지난 23일 바락 샤인 주한 이스라엘 대사관 대사대리를 초치했다. 이에 대해 26일 외교부 당국자는 지난 23일 이스라엘 대사대리에게 엄중한 인식을 전달하고 철저한 조사를 촉구했다”면서 “비인도적 처사가 사실로 밝혀지면 조치가 있어야 한다는 입장”이라고 말했다.)

Kim Ah-hyun and Kim Dong-hyun plan to hold a press conference on the 28th to reveal medical diagnosis results, including physical injuries from the assault. Activist Kim Dong-hyun has stated that after being captured, he was detained on a prison ship for over two days, and until the last day of the deportation process, his hands were bound behind his back while he suffered continuous assault and harsh treatment. He will also provide detailed explanations of the medical diagnosis results supporting this. (김아현씨와 김동현씨는 28일 기자회견을 열어 폭행으로 인한 신체적 손상 등 의료 진단 결과를 밝힐 예정이다. 김동현 활동가는 나포 이후 감옥선에 이틀 이상 구금된 뒤, 추방 절차가 진행되는 마지막 날까지 손이 뒤로 결박된 채 지속적인 폭행과 가혹행위를 당했다고 밝히고 있다. 이를 뒷받침하는 의료진 진단 결과도 자세히 설명할 예정이다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Yong-jin, “Bows Head in Apology”…Jang Dong-hyuk Criticizes ‘Starbucks Boycott’ [Gongdeok Pub] (정용진, “머리 숙여 사죄”에…‘스타벅스 불매’ 비판 나선 장동혁 [공덕포차])
item.description:
In connection with the controversy over Starbucks disparaging the May 18 Democratic Uprising, Shinsegae Group Chairman Jung Yong-jin personally appeared and apologized on the 26th. Chairman Jung said that day, “To the families of the May 18 victims, the families of the late activist Park Jong-chul, the citizens of Gwangju, and all the people of Korea who have felt deep hurt and disappointment over this incident, as Chairman of Shinsegae Group, I sincerely bow my head in apology and beg for forgiveness,” and he bent over to offer his apology. This marks the first time Chairman Jung has stood before the camera to apologize since taking office as chairman in March 2024. However, the Shinsegae Group explained that they could not find data proving any ‘intentionality’ in the incident. <<> People Power Party representative Jang Dong-hyuk raised his voice about Chairman Jung’s apology that day, saying, “Chairman Jung Yong-jin apologized and even took personnel actions against those involved, yet the president and minister are telling us not to drink Starbucks coffee—can we tolerate such a country?” On the other hand, Democratic Party representative Jeong Cheong-rae said, “Seeing the belated apology leaves a bitter taste,” adding, “Keep in mind that this cannot end with a simple verbal apology.” <<> Will the intentionality of the Starbucks tank incident eventually be revealed through a police investigation? How will the Starbucks controversy affect the upcoming June 3 local elections? Does the reappearance of former President Park Geun-hye, the ‘Queen of Elections,’ help the campaign of People Power Party candidates? We find out at Gongdeok Pub. Check it out in the video! <<> Production Team

item.title: President Lee makes 'surprise visit' to Jagalchi Market… "I washed my hands and waited to shake hands" (이 대통령, 자갈치시장 ‘깜짝 방문’…“악수하려고 손 씻고 기다렸어요”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Busan's Jagalchi Market on the 26th, continuing his on-site communication efforts by meeting with merchants and citizens. (이재명 대통령이 26일 부산 자갈치시장을 찾아 상인과 시민들과 만나 현장 소통 행보를 이어갔다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, said in a written briefing that day that the President and his wife visited Jagalchi Market and personally purchased natural sea squirts, hairtail squid, cuttlefish, tiger shrimp, sea cucumbers, natural abalone, and Dokdo shrimp using Onnuri gift certificates. The President raised his hand to greet citizens and merchants visiting the market, and citizens responded with "We love you." First Lady Kim also tasted Dokdo shrimp prepared by a merchant and said, "It's delicious." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 이 대통령 부부가 자갈치시장을 찾아 자연산 돌멍게와 한치, 갑오징어, 타이거 새우, 해삼, 자연산 전복과 독도새우 등을 온누리상품권으로 직접 구매했다고 전했다. 이 대통령은 시장을 찾는 시민과 상인을 향해 손을 들어 인사했고, 시민들은 “사랑합니다”라고 화답했다. 김 여사는 한 상인이 손질해 건넨 독도새우를 맛보며 “맛있다”라고 말하기도 했다.)

The President and First Lady also took selfies with citizens they met at the market. One merchant reportedly said, "I washed my hands and was waiting to shake hands," according to Senior Secretary Kang. When the presidential couple went up to the second floor, citizens who were eating stood up from their seats to shake hands with President Lee, and one citizen who shook hands exclaimed with joy, "I shook hands with President Lee!" (이 대통령 부부는 시장에서 만난 시민들과 ‘셀카’를 찍기도 했다. 어떤 상인은 “악수하려고 손 씻고 기다리고 있었다”고 말하기도 했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. 이 대통령 부부가 2층으로 올라가자 식사 중이던 시민들은 자리에서 일어나 이 대통령과 악수를 나눴고, 악수를 나눈 시민은 “이 대통령과 악수했어!”라고 기뻐하기도 했다.)

The President and First Lady had dinner at a second-floor restaurant with their aides, enjoying seafood and sliced raw fish purchased from first-floor shops. The President complimented the natural abalone he bought on the first floor as tasty and encouraged his aides to try it. (이 대통령 부부는 2층 식당에서 참모진과 함께 1층 상점에서 구매한 해산물과 회로 저녁 식사를 했다. 이 대통령은 1층에서 구매한 자연산 전복 맛이 좋다며 참모진들에게 권하기도 했다.)

The association president seated across from President Lee mentioned that the market was seeing renewed vitality with an increase in foreign tourists visiting Busan, including Chinese tourists, but also noted the still difficult situation and requested support and attention. President Lee expressed sympathy in response. (이 대통령의 맞은편에 앉은 조합장은 중국인 관광객을 비롯해 부산을 찾는 외국인 관광객이 늘어나 시장에 다시 활기가 돌고 있다면서도, 여전히 어려운 상황임을 언급하며 지원과 관심을 요청했다. 이에 이 대통령은 이에 공감을 표하기도 했다.)

Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon Suk-yeol-era Broadcasting Commission Duo Lee Jin-sook and Kim Tae-gyu Face Tough Road to Yeouido (‘윤석열 방통위’ 2인방 이진숙·김태규, ‘여의도 입성’ 녹록잖네)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong) and Kim Tae-gyu (Ulsan Nam-gu), the People Power Party candidates once dubbed the 'duo' of the Korea Communications Commission during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, are engaged in tight races against Democratic Party candidates in the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly. (윤석열 정부 시절 방송통신위원회 ‘2인방’으로 불렸던 이진숙(대구 달성)·김태규(울산 남갑) 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 국회의원 보궐선거에서 더불어민주당 후보들과 접전을 벌이는 것으로 나타났다.)

An automated response (ARS) survey of the Daegu Dalseong by-election conducted by Ace Research and Daegu Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation from the 17th to the 18th showed Democratic Party candidate Park Hyung-ryong at 41.7% and Lee Jin-sook at 48.5%. The gap between the two was within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Similarly, in Ulsan Nam-gu, an ARS survey by Ulsan Maeil Daily and KBS Ulsan conducted from the 22nd to the 23rd showed Democratic Party candidate Jeon Tae-jin at 38.0% and Kim Tae-gyu at 39.9%, also within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. ( 에이스리서치·대구문화방송이 지난 17∼18일 실시한 대구 달성 국회의원 보궐선거 무선 자동응답(ARS) 조사를 보면 박형룡 민주당 후보는 41.7%, 이진숙 후보 48.5%를 기록했다. 두 사람의 격차는 오차범위(±4.4%포인트) 안에 있었다. 울산 남갑 역시 울산매일신문·한국방송울산의 22∼23일 무선 자동응답 조사에서 전태진 민주당 후보 38.0%, 김태규 후보 39.9%의 지지율을 기록해, 격차는 오차범위(±4.4%포인트) 안이었다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

Both districts are traditionally considered strongholds for the People Power Party. Daegu Dalseong, where Lee is running, was the constituency of same-party Daegu mayoral candidate Chu Kyung-ho and is home to former President Park Geun-hye’s private residence. Chu won the 2024 general election with 75.3% support. Similarly, Ulsan Nam-gu was won by then-People Power Party member Kim Sang-wook (now the Democratic Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate) in the 2024 general election with 53.8% of the vote. ( 두곳은 모두 국민의힘 우세 지역으로 분류되는 곳이다. 이 후보가 나선 대구 달성군은 같은 당 추경호 대구시장 후보의 지역구였고, 박근혜 전 대통령의 사저가 있는 곳이다. 추 후보는 2024년 총선에서 75.3% 지지로 당선됐다. 울산 남갑 역시 2024년 총선 때 당시 국민의힘 소속이던 김상욱 의원(현 더불어민주당 울산시장 후보)이 53.8%를 얻어 당선된 곳이다.)

Political circles suggest this is due to the hardline conservative, 'Yoon again' image of candidates Lee Jin-sook and Kim Tae-gyu. Both have sparked controversy since their nominations with remarks such as "Is 'Yoon again' a criminal?" (Lee) and "It’s hasty to definitively say the martial law was illegal" (Kim). ( 정치권 주변에서는 이진숙 후보와 김태규 후보의 강성 보수, 윤 어게인 이미지 때문이라는 말이 나온다. 두 후보는 공천 당시부터 “윤 어게인이 범죄자냐”(이진숙), “비상계엄은 섣불리 위법하다고 단정하기 어렵다”(김태규)는 발언으로 논란을 빚었다. )

A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said, "I believe the backlash against candidate Kim Tae-gyu, who calls for 'Yoon again,' has significantly impacted the race." Candidate Park Hyung-ryong told the Hankyoreh, "In the Daegu region, there is criticism of Lee Jin-sook’s parachute nomination and an aversion to her hardline remarks." Lee initially ran in the People Power Party’s Daegu mayoral primary but was excluded from the nomination. After disputing her exclusion, she was nominated as the candidate for the Dalseong by-election. A People Power Party lawmaker from the Yeongnam region also said, "Candidate Lee Jin-sook, who has a history of hardline remarks in the region, is unpopular. Even if she wins, it will be by a narrow margin." However, a source from Lee Jin-sook’s campaign said, "These surveys were conducted immediately after candidate registration, when the candidate was not well-known. The gap has since widened significantly." ( 영남권의 한 민주당 의원은 “‘윤 어게인’을 외치는 김태규 후보에 대한 반감이 판세에 큰 영향을 미쳤다고 본다”고 말했다. 박형룡 후보는 한겨레에 “대구 지역에는 이진숙 후보의 낙하산 공천에 대한 원성이 있고, 강성 발언에 대한 기피감도 있는 것으로 이해한다”고 했다. 이 후보는 애초 국민의힘 대구시장 경선에 나섰다가 공천 배제됐다. 그는 공천 배제에 불복하다가 달성 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 공천받았다. 한 영남권 국민의힘 의원 역시 “지역에서 강성 발언을 일삼아온 이진숙 후보는 인기 없다. 이긴다 한들 간신히 이길 것”이라고 말했다. 다만 이진숙 후보 캠프 관계자는 “후보 등록 직후 후보가 잘 알려지지 않은 상태에서 실시된 조사들이다. 지금은 차이를 많이 벌렸다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Kim Hae-jeong, Jung Hye-min, and Ko Han-sol sea@hani.co.kr ( 김해정 정혜민 고한솔 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Pushing forward with '32-year secret' nuclear submarine project publicly, aiming for a speed race 'within Trump's term' (‘32년 비밀’ 핵잠사업 공개 추진…‘트럼프 임기내’ 속도전 노려)
item.description:
The government announced its goal to build and launch the first nuclear-powered submarine domestically by the mid-2030s, and to deploy it to front-line naval units by the late 2030s. However, there are many tasks to coordinate with the United States, such as securing nuclear fuel, leading to observations that future practical discussions may not be smooth. (정부가 2030년대 중반까지 첫 핵추진잠수함(핵잠)을 국내에서 건조해 진수하고 2030년대 후반에는 해군 일선부대에 배치한다는 목표를 밝혔다. 다만 핵연료 확보 등 미국과 협의해야 할 과제가 적지 않아 향후 실무 논의가 순탄하지 않을 것이란 관측이 나온다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek reported the basic plan for nuclear submarine development, the 'Jangbogo N Project,' at the '1st Future National Defense Strategy Committee' held at the Navy Submarine Command in Jinhae, South Gyeongsang Province, on the 26th, in the presence of President Lee Jae-myung. The 'Jangbogo N Project' refers to a project to build a submarine that inherits the spirit of the Jangbogo, Korea's first submarine, applies a nuclear-powered method to a next-generation model, and integrates cutting-edge new technologies. <<> Minister Ahn stated that the nuclear submarine will "play a key role in preparing against North Korea's submarine-based nuclear missile threats" and "contribute significantly to implementing an underwater kill chain, as it can monitor and track North Korean submarine forces more covertly and quickly than diesel submarines." <<> Military authorities are known to be reviewing a plan to build at least four nuclear submarines. Minister Ahn said, "We will develop and build nuclear submarines within the Republic of Korea." The plan involves producing the nuclear submarine platform (hull) and propulsion system (small nuclear reactor) domestically, while securing nuclear fuel for the reactor with U.S. assistance. <<> On this day, the government announced the basic plan, converting the nuclear submarine development, which had been pursued in secret for 32 years, into a public project. This shift to a public project can be seen as targeting both the alleviation of concerns about South Korea's nuclear armament and a push to solidify progress within the term of U.S. President Donald Trump. <<> Nuclear submarine development, which began in 1994 under the Kim Young-sam administration, has repeatedly been pursued and stalled over 32 years. The biggest obstacle has been U.S. concerns that "South Korea could arm itself with nuclear weapons." South Korea needs to receive nuclear fuel from the U.S. for the small nuclear reactor, the propulsion engine of the nuclear submarine, to operate it. Since the existing South Korea-U.S. Nuclear Agreement is based on civilian use, a separate agreement is needed to secure enriched uranium for military purposes. Article 91 of the U.S. Atomic Energy Act includes an exception clause allowing the transfer of nuclear materials for military use to other countries with presidential approval. Up until the release of the joint explanatory document last November, South Korea and the U.S. were tugging over this issue. As a result, observations suggest that future practical consultations will not be smooth. <<> Through the basic plan, South Korea has repeatedly emphasized that it will not build a strategic submarine carrying nuclear weapons, but rather a submarine armed with conventional weapons like torpedoes. The government's inclusion of a 'commitment' to transparently and firmly fulfill nuclear non-proliferation obligations in the basic plan is also aimed at dispelling concerns about South Korea's nuclear armament. The basic plan stated the fundamental position of 'not possessing any form of nuclear weapons and not developing nuclear weapons.' It further specified that "the Republic of Korea will jointly establish a safeguards system applicable to nuclear-powered submarines with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and fulfill a high level of nuclear non-proliferation obligations." South Korea plans to use low-enriched uranium at 20% or less, which cannot be used for nuclear weapons at all. <<> The announcement of the basic plan also has an aspect of speeding up the nuclear submarine project within the Trump administration's term. After the South Korea-U.S. summit agreement last October, follow-up consultations on nuclear submarines between the two countries have been delayed due to pending issues such as the Coupang problem and delays in implementing investments in the U.S. Accordingly, the government's intent is to preemptively announce the basic plan to accelerate the pace of nuclear submarine development. <<> Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr ( 안규백 국방부 장관은 26일 이재명 대통령이 참석한 가운데 경남 진해 해군잠수함사령부에서 열린 ‘제1회 미래국방전략위원회’에서 핵잠 개발 기본계획인 ‘장보고 엔(N)사업’을 보고했다. ‘장보고 엔사업’은 대한민국 최초의 잠수함인 장보고함의 정신을 계승한 차세대 모델(Next generation)에 핵추진 방식(Nuclear powered)을 적용해 첨단 신기술(Neo technology)을 집약한 잠수함을 구축하겠다는 사업을 뜻한다.)

item.title: Amid Differences Between South Korea and U.S. on Wartime Operational Control (OPCON) Transition Timing, President Lee Says "Defending Ourselves Is the Foundation of the Nation" (한미 ‘전작권 전환’ 시기 이견 속 이 대통령 “스스로 지키는 게 국가의 근본”)
item.description:
On the 26th, President Lee Jae-myung emphasized the swift return of wartime operational control (OPCON) during a Cabinet meeting and the 1st Future Defense Strategy Committee. This reaffirmed his commitment to reclaiming OPCON, even as there has been a temperature difference between South Korea and the U.S. regarding the timing of the transition. (이재명 대통령이 26일 국무회의와 제1회 미래국방전략위원회에서 거듭 신속한 전시작전통제권(전작권) 환수를 강조했다. 최근 전작권 전환 시기를 둘러싼 한-미 간 온도 차가 있는 가운데 환수 의지를 다시 확인한 것이다.)

At the "1st Future Defense Strategy Committee" held at the Naval Submarine Command in Jinhae-gu, Changwon City, South Gyeongsang Province, President Lee stressed that recovering OPCON is a "core element of self-reliant national defense" and emphasized that a specific roadmap for the OPCON recovery would be completed through consultations between South Korea and the U.S. (이 대통령은 이날 경남 창원시 진해구에 있는 해군잠수함사령부에서 열린 ‘제1회 미래국방전략위원회’에서 전작권 회복이 “자주국방의 핵심 요소”임을 강조하며, 한-미 간 협의를 통해 구체적인 전작권 회복 로드맵을 완성해나가겠다고 강조했다.)

During the meeting, Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-back presented a detailed roadmap. Minister Ahn stated, "The Republic of Korea possesses strong military power, but among the approximately 190 countries in the world, it is the only one without wartime operational control," adding, "After completing verification of the Full Operational Capability (FOC) related to the mission performance capability of the future Combined Forces Command (following the OPCON transition) this year, I will propose the timing of the OPCON transition to the President to make the recovery of OPCON a reality." (안규백 국방부 장관은 이날 회의에서 구체적인 로드맵을 제시했다. 안 장관은 “대한민국은 강력한 군사력을 보유하고 있지만, 전세계 190여개 나라 중 전작권이 없는 유일무이한 국가”라며 “올해 (전작권 전환 이후 전작권을 행사할 미래연합사령부의 임무수행능력과 관련해) 완전운용능력(FOC)에 대한 검증을 마친 뒤 대통령께 전작권 시기를 건의해 전작권 회복을 가시화하도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

South Korea and the U.S. completed the first stage, Initial Operational Capability (IOC), evaluation and verification for the future Combined Forces Command in 2019 and 2020, respectively. The second stage, Full Operational Capability (FOC) evaluation, was completed in 2022, and it is scheduled to be verified at the 58th South Korea-U.S. Annual Security Consultative Meeting this fall. The defense ministers of South Korea and the U.S. will eventually propose a transition date to the presidents of both countries after completing the third stage, Full Mission Capability (FMC) evaluation and verification. (한·미는 미래연합사령부에 대해 1단계인 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가와 검증을 각각 2019년과 2020년 마쳤다. 2단계인 완전운용능력 평가는 2022년 마쳤고, 올해 가을 열리는 제58차 한-미 연례안보협의회의에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 한·미 국방장관은 3단계인 완전임무수행능력(FMC) 평가·검증까지 끝낸 뒤 한·미 대통령에게 전환 일자를 건의하게 된다.)

President Lee's remarks draw attention because South Korea and the U.S. recently showed subtle differences in views regarding the timing of the OPCON transition. The Ministry of National Defense predicts that if consultations between South Korea and the U.S. proceed smoothly, the return of OPCON could be possible as early as late 2027. However, U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) Commander General Xavier Brunson proposed the timing of the OPCON transition as the first quarter of 2029 during a hearing before the U.S. House Armed Services Committee on April 22 (local time). Since last year, General Brunson has repeatedly emphasized in various public forums that what matters in the OPCON transition is not the timing but the fulfillment of conditions. (이 대통령의 발언이 주목받는 이유는 최근 전작권 전환 시기를 두고 한·미가 미묘한 견해차를 노출했기 때문이다. 국방부는 한-미 간 협의가 원활하게 이뤄질 경우 이르면 2027년 말께 전작권 환수가 가능할 것이라고 전망한다. 그러나 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 지난 4월22일(현지시각) 미국 하원 군사위원회에서 전작권 전환 시기를 2029년 1분기로 제시했다. 지난해부터 브런슨 사령관은 각종 공개 석상에서 전작권 전환에서 중요한 것은 시기가 아니라 조건 충족이라고 거듭 강조하고 있다.)

The South Korean government explains that the timing of the OPCON return falls within the realm of political decisions by the leaders of both countries. On the 17th, regarding General Brunson's remarks, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac indirectly rebutted by stating, "This is an issue that can be addressed at the level of dialogue between heads of state or at a high-level meeting representing the heads of state." (한국 정부는 전작권 환수 시기는 양국 대통령의 정치적 결정 영역에 있다고 설명한다. 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 지난 17일 브런슨 사령관의 발언에 관해 “정상 간의 또는 정상을 대변할 수 있는 고위급 대화 차원에서 다뤄질 수 있는 문제”라고 에둘러 반박했다.)

During the meeting, when Minister Ahn said, "Even if OPCON were returned tomorrow, there would be no significant problem in defending ourselves," President Lee emphasized, "It's not that there's a big problem; it would be more accurate to say there is no problem at all." In his closing remarks, President Lee also stated, "In the field of national defense, it seems that a lot of dependent thinking still remains," adding, "Defending oneself with one's own strength is the foundation of a nation." (이날 안 장관이 “내일 전작권이 회수되더라도 (우리를) 스스로 지키는 데 크게 문제가 없다”고 말하자, 이 대통령은 “크게 문제가 있는 게 아니라 아무 문제가 없다고 해야 맞다”고 강조하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 마무리 발언에서도 “국방 분야에 있어서는 여전히 의존적 사고가 많이 남아 있는 거 같다”며 “스스로의 힘으로 스스로를 지킨다는 건 국가의 근본”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ulsan mayor candidacy unification between Democratic and Progressive parties faces collapse... Kim Sang-uk belatedly demands 'anti-strategic voting' measure (민주·진보 울산시장 후보 단일화 무산 위기…김상욱, 뒤늦게 ‘역선택 방지’ 요구)
item.description:
With three days left until early voting for the June 3 local elections, the unification of Ulsan mayor candidates between Kim Sang-uk of the Democratic Party of Korea and Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party is on the verge of collapse. The two parties initially agreed not to include an 'anti-strategic voting clause' in the unification opinion poll, but the Democratic Party requested a redo of the poll with an anti-strategic voting mechanism in place, halting the primary. The Progressive Party maintains that the unification poll should be resumed as previously agreed. <<> Candidate Kim Sang-uk held a press conference at his election office in Nam-gu, Ulsan, on the 26th, saying, "I only found out after the opinion poll started that there was no anti-strategic voting mechanism," and proposed restarting the primary poll with an anti-strategic voting clause included. He cited evidence of interference in the poll by supporters of the People Power Party. <<> However, the 'Ulsan Mayor Unification Opinion Poll Agreement' between the two parties, released by Candidate Kim Jong-hoon's side, did not originally include an anti-strategic voting clause. Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side attributed this to "strong demands from the Progressive Party." In contrast, Bang Seok-su, chairman of the Progressive Party's Ulsan city chapter, said, "That's completely untrue," adding, "We agreed on the competition method, and now that the competition is almost over, they realize they're at a disadvantage and want to start over—how convincing is that?" <<> The Progressive Party pointed out that Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side, after checking interim poll results, may have halted the primary under the pretext of 'external interference' due to concerns about unfavorable outcomes. Shin Chang-hyeon, secretary-general of the Progressive Party, said, "On the 24th, the first day of the poll, a contact from Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side called the Progressive Party's person in charge, citing specific figures and insisting that the survey should be stopped," raising allegations of premature disclosure of poll results. Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side countered, "We didn't see specific figures. We just heard from the polling agency that there was an 'unusual flow (in the data).'" <<> Both parties have stated they will keep the option of unification open for discussion until the 28th, the deadline for indicating 'withdrawal' on advance ballots, but unification seems unlikely. Cho Seung-rae, head of the Democratic Party's general election strategy committee, said at a press briefing, "We are continuing negotiations, but the outlook doesn't seem bright. It's a situation where we may have to brace ourselves for each running independently." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 사전투표를 사흘 앞두고 김상욱 더불어민주당 후보와 김종훈 진보당 후보의 울산시장 후보 단일화가 무산될 위기에 놓였다. 애초 두 당은 단일화 여론조사에서 ‘역선택 방지 조항’을 넣지 않기로 합의했는데, 민주당이 “역선택 방지 장치를 마련한 여론조사를 다시 하자”고 요구하며 경선이 멈춰섰다. 진보당은 “합의대로 여론조사 단일화를 재개하자”는 입장이다.)

item.title: Two Days Until Early Voting... Democratic Party Says "Close Races in 6 Regions Including Busan and Daegu," People Power Party Claims "Beyond the Golden Cross in Yeongnam" (사전투표 D-2…민주 “부산·대구 등 6곳 접전” 국힘 “영남 골든크로스 넘어”)
item.description:
On the 26th, three days before the June 3 local elections' early voting period (May 29-30), analysis suggests the election landscape is becoming foggy as regions previously considered strongholds for the Democratic Party of Korea are turning into tight contests. With the Democratic Party pushing for a special counsel bill to investigate alleged election rigging, the ruling and opposition parties' support bases have become firmly entrenched. Additionally, starting from the 28th until the close of voting on election day, the publication of opinion polls is banned, making it difficult for both parties to predict the direction of late-deciding voters. <<> Cho Seung-rae, the general election campaign chief of the Democratic Party of Korea, held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day. Regarding the race for metropolitan mayors and governors, he stated, "Close battles are underway in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang Province, and North Jeolla Province," adding, "Our goal is to win as many of these six competitive regions as possible." He assessed that the party is "stably leading" in nine other areas—Incheon, Gyeonggi Province, Gangwon Province, Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong Province, North Chungcheong Province, Gwangju/South Jeolla Province, and Jeju Island—but frankly acknowledged, "We have to admit that the People Power Party is stably leading in North Gyeongsang Province." <<> In the highly anticipated Daegu mayoral race, for instance, Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate, was initially expected to make a strong showing about a month ago. However, as election day approaches, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho has mounted a rapid comeback, turning it into an ultra-tight contest. According to a poll conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on May 24-25 for CBS, Choo Kyung-ho's approval rating stood at 50.1%, leading Kim Boo-kyum (41.1%) by 9.0 percentage points, outside the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points) in the wireless phone survey on Daegu mayoral support. In North Jeolla Province, a traditionally strong area for the Democratic Party, independent candidate Kim Gwan-young—who was expelled from the party over the so-called "money envelope scandal"—is ahead of Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek, according to a poll. The New Jeonbuk Daily-Hangil Research survey on provincial governor support in North Jeolla (via wireless phone) showed Kim Gwan-young at 47.3%, leading Lee Won-taek (38.7%) outside the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) <<> The Democratic Party is focusing its efforts on rallying its support base. "Elections always involve an opponent. When conservatives consolidate, Democratic Party supporters and presidential supporters also consolidate," Cho said. "Making that happen is the main goal of our campaign." A Democratic Party official elaborated to *The Hankyoreh*, saying, "In Seoul, we believe the outcome could vary depending on the voter turnout." <<> The People Power Party believes the situation is turning in its favor as conservative voters consolidate in the final stretch. item.title: Kim Min-jeon's Explanation of "Oppa" Remark Sparks Criticism: "Consideration? It's Hypocrisy" (“오빠 발언, 편하게 지나가라고…” 김민전 해명에 “배려? 내로남불” 비판)
item.description:
Kim Min-jeon, a lawmaker from the People Power Party (PPP), drew criticism from the Justice Party for explaining that her remark to early teenage girls during a campaign rally for Byun Jae-il’s by-election in Busan’s Buk-gu district—"There are many handsome oppas here"—was made out of consideration for the girls. The Justice Party argued that this hypocrisy in politics is unbearable. They pointed out that Kim and the PPP had harshly criticized Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo earlier this month over their own "oppa" remarks, yet now they are trying to justify their own similar comment as "consideration." <<> On the 26th, the Justice Party issued a statement saying, "Forcing young students to call adult men 'oppa' and imposing intimacy is itself an outdated gender stereotype behavior." <<> Earlier, on the 25th, Kim took to the streets with candidate Park in Busan’s Manduk-dong area for a campaign event. During this, about eight girls estimated to be in their early teens tried to pass by the campaign spot, which was being livestreamed on YouTube by Park. The narrow street was crowded with Kim, Park, and men holding cameras on both sides. As the girls hesitated to pass, Kim waved at them and said, "Hello. There are many handsome oppas here." Then, a man holding a camera said in a casual tone, "Just go, it's fine." The girls, seemingly aware of the camera, covered their faces with their phones and quickly walked past Kim and Park. <<> After media reports sparked controversy, Kim took to Facebook to explain. She stated, "There were about 10 men who looked to be in their 20s at the scene, and the girls couldn't get through, so I said it to encourage them not to be scared and to pass freely." She added, "It's being reported as if I called Candidate Park 'oppa,' but I never did that." Kim also referenced the controversy over Ha’s "oppa" remark, saying, "Unlike someone, I never forced them to call me 'oppa.'" <<> In response, the Justice Party criticized, "Kim explained that she wasn't referring to Candidate Park, but do you think that's a valid explanation?" Regardless of whether Park was addressed, they argued the remark was "inappropriate." <<> The Justice Party then pointed out the PPP’s double standards. They said, "Just weeks ago, the PPP fiercely criticized Ha's 'oppa' controversy, calling it 'child abuse,' 'sexual harassment,' and a 'lack of gender sensitivity,' even using the term 'oppa coercion offender.' But when their own lawmaker repeats the same behavior, they try to gloss over their poor gender sensitivity under the guise of 'consideration.'" <<> The Justice Party urged the PPP to "apply the same harsh criticism they dished out to themselves" and emphasized, "We can no longer tolerate the hypocrisy of calling it consideration when they do it, but sexual harassment when others do it." Regarding Kim's comment about not forcing anyone to call her 'oppa' "unlike someone," they added, "When a problem arises, the proper response is immediate reflection and an apology, not blaming others by saying 'unlike someone.' That's the current standard of the PPP." <<> The Justice Party, which had previously urged Ha to reflect on his lack of gender sensitivity and apologize to the public over his 'oppa' comment, now said, "The same goes for Kim Min-jeon. Don't package this as 'consideration'; apologize to the public." They added, "Both the PPP and the Democratic Party should acknowledge their lack of gender sensitivity and conduct checks on this issue." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (김민전 국민의힘 의원이 박민식 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세 도중 10대 초반 여학생들에게 “여기 잘생긴 오빠들 많아요”라고 발언한 데 대해 ‘여학생들을 배려한 것’이라는 취지로 해명하자 정의당이 “내로남불 정치를 더 참아줄 수 없다”고 비판했다. 김 의원을 포함해 국민의힘 쪽에서 이달 초 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 하정우 민주당 부산 북갑 후보의 ‘오빠’ 발언 논란 당시 두 사람을 거세게 비판하곤 정작 자신들의 ‘오빠’ 발언은 ‘배려’로 포장하려 든다는 것이다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye makes a move but… Kim Jong-in: "Queen of Elections is a thing of the past, the mood is already set" (박근혜 뛴다지만…김종인 “선거의 여왕 옛말, 분위기 이미 확정”)
item.description:
Former People Power Party (PPP) emergency steering committee chairman Kim Jong-in said regarding the June 3 local elections, "The election is proceeding with the PPP having completely lost trust as a political party," and added, "It wouldn't be surprising if the results turn out similar to the 2018 local government elections." (김종인 전 국민의힘 비상대책위원장이 6·3 지방선거와 관련해 “국민의힘이 정당으로서의 신뢰를 완전히 잃어버린 상태에서 선거가 진행되고 있다”며 “2018년 지자체 선거 같은 결과가 나오지 않겠나”라고 말했다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio's "Park Sung-tae's News Show" on the 27th, former Chairman Kim stated, "Since the PPP is not showing the image of a normal political party, I don't think it will differ much from the initial expectation that the Democratic Party would win overwhelmingly." In the 2018 gubernatorial and mayoral elections, the PPP (then the Liberty Korea Party) lost all but Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province to the Democratic Party. (김 전 위원장은 27일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 “국민의힘이 정상적인 정당으로서의 모습을 보이지 못하고 있어 (선거 초반에) 민주당이 압승을 한다고 예상한 것과 그렇게 큰 차이가 나오지 않으리라고 본다”고 말했다. 지난 2018년 광역단체장선거에서 국민의힘(당시 자유한국당)은 광역자치단체장 선거에서 대구·경북을 빼고 모두 민주당에 자리를 내줬다.)

Regarding former President Park Geun-hye's appearance on the election scene to support the PPP, former Chairman Kim said, "I am very skeptical about whether that will carry any significance." (김 전 위원장은 박근혜 전 대통령이 국민의힘을 지원하기 위해 선거판에 등장한 것을 두고 “그게 어떤 의미를 가질 것이라는 데 대해 굉장히 회의적”이라고 말했다.)

He said, "In the 2011 Seoul mayoral by-election, when candidate Na Kyung-won and candidate Park Won-soon competed, then-lawmaker Park Geun-hye initially acted as if she wouldn't directly intervene but eventually did so actively, and Candidate Na lost," adding, "'Queen of Elections' is a term from before 2011." He further added, "This is an election held after a new government was formed following President Yoon Suk-yeol's impeachment, and the election atmosphere itself is already set. The appearance of a specific person to offer some assistance cannot change that." (그는 “2011년 서울시장 보궐선거에서 나경원 후보와 박원순 후보가 경합할 때 박근혜 당시 의원이 처음에는 선거에 직접적인 개입을 안 하는 척하다가 결국 열심히 개입했는데, 나 후보가 졌다”며 ‘선거의 여왕’이라는 수식어에 대해 “그건 2011년 이전의 상황에서 나온 얘기”라고 잘라 말했다. 그러면서 “윤석열 대통령 탄핵 이후 새로운 정부가 탄생한 이후 실시되는 선거이고, 선거 분위기 자체는 이미 확정돼 있는 상황인데, 특정인이 나와서 조금 조력한다고 해서 영향을 끼칠 수 있는 건 아니다”라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding PPP lawmaker Shin Dong-wook's recent statement that "there could be a different assessment of the facts surrounding President Park's impeachment process," former Chairman Kim said, "The impeachment has already passed, so what assessment are you trying to make?" and added, "President Park, like President Yoon, was impeached, and she must keenly understand her position in the perception of the general public." (김 전 위원장은 신동욱 국민의힘 의원이 최근 “박 대통령의 탄핵 과정에 대한 사실은 다른 평가가 이뤄질 수도 있다”고 말한 것과 관련해 “이미 탄핵이 지나간 상황인데 평가를 뭘 어떻게 하겠다는 건가”라며 “박 대통령 역시 윤 대통령과 마찬가지로 탄핵을 받았고, 일반 국민들의 인식 속에 어떠한 위치에 있는지를 냉정하게 판단할 줄 알아야 한다”고 말했다.)

By Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong Un Oversees Missile Test Launches... "An Event Signifying Technological Progress" (김정은 미사일 시험 발사 참관…“기술적 진보 의미하는 사변”)
item.description:
North Korea conducted tests of its newly developed lightweight multipurpose missile launch system and multiple-launch tactical cruise missile weapon system. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 27th that these weapons tests were carried out the previous day, with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman and Workers' Party General Secretary Kim Jong Un in attendance. As part of the five-year national defense development plan, the tests "analyzed and assessed the power of the 'special mission warhead' of tactical ballistic missiles, the reliability of the ultra-precision autonomous guidance navigation system for extended-range 240mm rocket shells, and the artificial intelligence-guided precision targeting capability of tactical cruise missiles," the agency stated. <<> Chairman Kim expressed satisfaction with the tests and reportedly gave a positive evaluation of the tactical cruise missiles to be deployed to long-range artillery brigades along the southern border. KCNA stated that the tactical cruise missiles incorporate an ultra-precision autonomous navigation system that calculates the missile's own position without external assistance, a terrain contour matching navigation system that compares actual terrain with pre-built topographic data to determine the current location, and an artificial intelligence terminal guidance function that recognizes targets before impact. North Korea claims these missiles can precisely strike targets at a range of 100 kilometers using a combined glide and propulsion flight method. As Chairman Kim mentioned, if this weapon system is deployed along the military demarcation line at North Korea's southern border, most of the Seoul metropolitan area would fall within its range. <<> Chairman Kim praised the tests, stating, "The development tests of key weapon systems are a clear signal of our military strength renewal and an event signifying great technological progress in enhancing our military's combat capabilities." He added, "The fire control systems and automation systems of all launch vehicles have been completely updated to meet the conditions of modern warfare, improving combat applicability." <<> Chairman Kim also noted, "The current situation is urging continuous military strength renewal," and said, "Building the most modern and powerful artillery force is our top policy direction in force building, and it is an essential condition for our military to possess destructive power that would make the theoretical survival of hostile forces impossible." He added that such capability is "an important link in war deterrence and a responsible exercise." <<> However, news of these test launches was not reported in the Rodong Sinmun, the newspaper read by North Korean residents. <<> On the 26th, the Joint Chiefs of Staff stated that North Korea launched multiple types of projectiles, including short-range ballistic missiles, from the Jeongju area in North Pyongan Province into the West Sea around 1:00 PM. The short-range ballistic missile flew approximately 80 kilometers. The military believes North Korea launched missiles and rocket artillery in a "mixed firing" tactic. Mixed firing is a tactic that demonstrates air defense evasion and strike capabilities. <<> By Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 새로 개발한 경량급 다용도 미사일 발사체계와 다연장 전술 순항 미사일 무기체계 시험을 진행했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Making Busan the Maritime Capital... Ushering in the Era of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries" (이 대통령 “부산을 해양 수도로…해수부 시대 열 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 27th, "I will fully establish Busan as the undeniable maritime capital of the Republic of Korea and develop the southeastern region into a 'Southern Maritime Capital Zone' to achieve balanced national development." (이재명 대통령이 27일 “부산을 명실상부한 대한민국 해양 수도로, 동남권을 ‘남부 해양수도권’으로 육성해 국가균형발전을 완성하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The President made these remarks while attending the 31st Sea Day ceremony held in Yeongdo-gu, Busan. He said, "I will fully inaugurate the era of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries in Busan," adding, "We will swiftly establish a maritime cluster that includes shipping companies, related public institutions, and the maritime court, for which legislation has been completed, as well as the Southeastern Investment Corporation, as soon as parliamentary discussions conclude, and quickly finalize the project." (이 대통령은 이날 부산 영도구에서 열린 제31회 바다의날 기념식에 참석해 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “부산에 본격적인 해양수산부 시대를 활짝 열어젖히겠다”라며 “해운기업과 관련 공공기관은 물론, 입법이 완료된 해사법원을 조속히 설립하고, 국회 논의가 끝나는 대로 동남권 투자 공사까지 모두 직접된 해양클러스터를 신속하게 완성하겠다”고 했다.)

He also mentioned that after the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries relocated to Busan, competition rates for universities in the Busan area, including the National Korea Maritime & Ocean University, reached record highs. He stated, "The government will surely meet the expectations of young people who have chosen the sea to discover the future of the Republic of Korea and seek new opportunities." (이어 해수부 부산 이전 이후 국립해양대를 비롯한 부산 지역 대학 경쟁률이 최고치를 기록한 점을 언급하며 “바다에서 대한민국의 미래를 발견하고 새로운 기회를 찾기 위해 바다를 선택한 청년 여러분의 기대에 정부가 반드시 부응하겠다”라고 말했다.)

Regarding the vision for the Southern Maritime Capital Zone centered on Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang Province, President Lee emphasized, "This is not a simple regional development project. It is a survival strategy for the Republic of Korea to compete fiercely, and a balanced growth strategy that directly links the vision of a maritime powerhouse to jobs and regional vitality." He added, "We will connect the southeastern region, including Busan, into a new economic zone full of possibilities and opportunities. We will expand logistics infrastructure connecting ports, airports, railways, and roads, and build a marine tourism belt encompassing the entire southern coast, fostering it into a maritime economic zone that competes proudly with the world." Regarding the shipping industry, he further noted, "We will foster our shipping and port industries as national strategic industries, recognizing that they are not mere logistics industries but core industries that firmly support the nation's economy and security." (이 대통령은 부산·울산·경남을 중심으로 한 남부 해양수도권 구상을 두고는 “단순한 지역개발 사업이 아니다”라며 “대한민국이 치열한 경쟁에서 살아남기 위한 생존 전략이자 해양강국의 비전을 일자리와 지역의 활력으로 직결시키는 균형성장 전략”이라고 강조했다. 그러면서 “부산을 비롯한 동남권을 가능성과 기회가 넘치는 새로운 경제권으로 연결하겠다”라며 “항만과 공항, 철도와 도로가 이어지는 물류 인프라를 확충하고 남해안 전체를 아우르는 해양 관광벨트를 구축해 세계와 당당히 경쟁하는 해양 경제권으로 키워내겠다”고 말했다. 해운산업에 대해서도 “단순한 물류 산업이 아니라 국가의 경제와 안보를 굳건히 지탱하는 핵심 산업이라는 인식 아래 우리 해운·항만사업을 국가전략산업으로 육성해나갈 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Singapore Foreign Minister meets North Korea's Choe Son-hui... Tomorrow, talks with Minister Cho Tae-yul (싱가포르 외무장관, 북 최선희 만나…내일은 조현 장관과 회담)
item.description:
North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui met with Singapore's Minister for Foreign Affairs Vivian Balakrishnan, who is currently touring China, North Korea, and South Korea in that order. (최선희 북한 외무상이 중국·북한·한국 순서로 순방 중인 비비안 발라크리쉬난 싱가포르 외교장관과 회담했다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 27th that Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui held talks with Minister Balakrishnan at the Pyongyang Diplomatic Compound the previous day (26th). The agency stated that during the meeting, they exchanged views on ways to develop bilateral relations between North Korea and Singapore, as well as on regional and international issues. They are also believed to have discussed issues related to the Korean Peninsula. On the North Korean side, Vice Foreign Minister Park Sang-gil and North Korea's ambassador extraordinary and plenipotentiary to Singapore, Ri Gil-song, participated. (조선중앙통신은 최선희 외무상이 전날(26일) 평양의사당에서 발라크리쉬난 장관과 회담했다고 27일 보도했다. 회담에선 북한과 싱가포르의 양자관계 발전 방안과 더불어 지역 및 국제 문제들에 대한 의견을 교환했다고 통신은 전했다. 이들은 한반도 문제도 논의했을 것으로 보인다. 북한 쪽에선 박상길 외무성 부상과 리길성 싱가포르 주재 북한 특명전권대사가 참가했다.)

The agency reported that Foreign Minister Choe expressed "the position of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to strengthen and develop the DPRK-Singapore friendly cooperative relations in line with the aspirations and wishes of the two peoples." In response, Minister Balakrishnan stated, "The government and people of Singapore hope to further strengthen friendly cooperative relations with the DPRK," and "wish the Korean people greater success in their efforts for national prosperity." (최 외무상은 “조선(북한)-싱가포르 친선 협조 관계를 두 나라 인민의 지향과 염원에 맞게 강화 발전시켜나가려는 조선민주주의인민공화국 정부의 입장”을 표명했다고 통신은 밝혔다. 이에 발라크리쉬난 장관은 “싱가포르 정부와 인민은 조선과의 친선협조관계가 보다 강화되기를 희망하고 있다”면서 “나라의 부강번영을 위한 조선 인민의 노력이 보다 큰 성과를 거두기를 축원한다”고 했다.)

Minister Balakrishnan is scheduled to meet with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul on the 28th in Seoul for a breakfast meeting. A foreign ministry official told reporters on the 26th, the day of the Singapore-North Korea meeting, "It will likely be an opportunity to hear detailed accounts of the results of the visit to North Korea (from Minister Balakrishnan)," adding, "We are closely monitoring North Korea's active diplomatic moves, and there will naturally be an exchange of views on this matter with Minister Balakrishnan." Singapore, which maintains a neutral diplomatic stance on inter-Korean issues, previously provided the venue for the first North Korea-U.S. summit between then-U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un in June 2018. (발라크리쉬난 장관은 28일 서울에서도 조현 외교부 장관과도 만나 조찬을 겸한 회담을 할 예정이다. 외교부 당국자는 싱가포르-북한 회담 당일인 26일 기자들과 만나 “(발라크리쉬난 장관으로부터) 방북 결과에 대해 상세한 이야기를 듣는 기회가 될 것 같다”며 “북한이 외교적 행보를 적극 해 나가는 모습을 예의주시하고 있고, 발라크리쉬난 장관과도 이런 부분에 대한 자연스러운 의견 교환이 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 남북 문제에 중립적 외교 기조를 가진 싱가포르는 지난 2018년 6월 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 1차 북미 정상회담을 할 때 장소를 제공한 바 있다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Safety First"... Suspending Campaign and Visiting Seosomun for Second Consecutive Day (오세훈 “안전 최우선”…선거운동 중단하고 연이틀 서소문 방문)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, visited the collapse site of the Seosomun elevated road demolition on the 27th, the day after the accident, and urged safety management. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 붕괴 사고 이튿날인 27일에도 현장을 찾아 안전관리를 당부했다.)

The candidate arrived at the scene of the Seosomun elevated road demolition accident in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, around 9:40 a.m. on this day. It was his second consecutive day visiting the site following the previous day. (오 후보는 이날 오전 9시40분께 서울 서대문구 서소문 고가차도 철거 사고 현장을 방문했다. 전날에 이어 연이틀 현장을 찾았다.)

According to Oh's camp, the candidate met with Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Kim Yoon-deok at the scene and urged, "Above all, safety must be the top priority," asking to "devote best efforts to safety management to prevent additional accidents, and to ensure thorough site recovery and swift resumption of rail operations." (오 후보는 현장에서 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관을 만나 “무엇보다 안전이 최우선되어야 한다”며 “추가 사고가 발생하지 않도록 안전관리에 최선의 노력을 기울임과 동시에 현장 수습과 빠른 철도 운행 재개에 만전을 기해달라”고 당부했다고 오 후보 쪽은 전했다.)

Afterward, Oh held meetings with campaign officials to discuss accident response and management. The candidate suspended his election campaign immediately after the collapse at the Seosomun elevated road demolition site on the previous day to assess the situation and respond, and has not embarked on any public schedule as of this day. Oh's camp stated, "We plan to thoroughly investigate the circumstances of this accident and focus all capabilities until the situation is fully resolved." (이후 오 후보는 캠프에서 선대위 관계자들과 회의를 갖고 사고 수습 등에 관한 논의를 이어갔다. 오 후보는 전날 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 붕괴 사고 발생 직후 사태 파악과 대응을 위해 선거운동을 중단해, 이날까지도 공개 일정에 나서지 않고 있다. 오 후보 측은 “이번 사고의 경위를 철저히 파악하고, 사태가 완전히 수습될 때까지 모든 역량을 집중할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] President Lee to hold press conference marking first year in office on June 8… At 10 a.m. at Yeongbingwan ([속보] 이 대통령, 6월8일 취임 1년 기자회견…오전 10시 영빈관서)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung’s first anniversary press conference will be held on the 8th of next month. (이재명 대통령 취임 1주년 기자회견이 다음 달 8일 개최된다.)

Chief of the Presidential Office’s Public Relations and Communications, Lee Gyu-yeon, stated in a briefing at the presidential office on the 27th, “The president’s first anniversary press conference will take place on June 8 at 10 a.m. at Yeongbingwan.” The event is scheduled to last 100 minutes, with approximately 160 domestic and foreign journalists in attendance. The press conference will be divided into three areas: livelihoods and economy, politics and foreign affairs and security, and society and culture, with no pre-set script. (이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 27일 청와대 브리핑에서 “이 대통령 취임 1주년 기자회견이 6월8일 오전 10시 영빈관에서 진행된다”고 말했다. 시간은 100분이 예정돼 있고, 내외신 기자 160여명이 참석한다. 기자회견은 민생·경제, 정치·외교안보, 사회·문화 등 3분야로 나누어 진행되고, 정해진 각본은 따로 없다.)

Chief Lee said, “This press conference will be an opportunity to look back on the past year of the people’s sovereignty government and to clearly present the vision and key tasks for the second year of the administration.” (이 수석은 “이번 기자회견은 국민주권정부의 지난 1년을 돌아보고, 국정 2년차 비전과 주요 과제를 소상히 밝히는 자리가 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Ulsan Mayor Candidate Unification Re-run…Progressive Party's Kim Jong-hoon Accepts Kim Sang-uk's Demand (울산시장 후보 단일화 재경선…진보당 김종훈, 김상욱 요구 수용)
item.description:
Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate, stated on the 27th, "I accept Kim Sang-uk, the Democratic Party candidate's demand for a re-run of the primary." The progressive camp's unification, which was on the verge of collapse, appears poised to gain sudden momentum. (김종훈 진보당 울산시장 후보가 “김상욱 더불어민주당 후보의 재경선 요구를 받아들인다”라고 27일 밝혔다. 무산 위기에 접어들었던 진보진영 단일화가 다시 급물살을 타게 될 것으로 보인다.)

Candidate Kim Jong-hoon held an emergency press conference at 1 p.m. that day at his election office in Nam-gu, Ulsan, and said, "I deliberated long and hard. I considered the urgent need to prevent continued conflict and discord within the democratic and progressive camp, and the responsibility to unite the hearts of all citizens who wish to bring down the insurrection." (김종훈 후보는 이날 오후 1시 울산 남구 선거사무소에서 긴급 기자회견을 열고 “고심하고 또 고심했다. 민주 진보 진영의 갈등과 반목이 지속되어서는 안 된다는 절실함, 내란 청산을 바라는 모든 시민의 마음을 하나로 모아내야 한다는 책임감을 생각했다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

Candidate Kim Jong-hoon emphasized, "Right now, it's not about whose side someone is on. Now, let's not divide between Kim Jong-hoon and Kim Sang-uk, but become one side for 'ending the insurrection.'" (김종훈 후보는 “지금 우리에게는 누구와 누구의 편이 따로 없다”라며 “이제 김종훈과 김상욱 그 누구의 편을 가르지 말고 ‘내란 청산’을 위해 한 편이 되어 달라”라고 강조했다)

Candidates Kim Sang-uk and Kim Jong-hoon had conducted a unification public opinion poll on the 23rd and 24th and planned to announce the primary results on the 24th. However, Candidate Kim Sang-uk suddenly halted the primary poll, citing evidence of interference by supporters of the People Power Party, pushing the unification into a crisis. Candidate Kim Sang-uk proposed a new public opinion poll over two days, on the 27th and 28th, with clauses to prevent strategic voting, while Candidate Kim Jong-hoon had insisted on releasing the results of the previous poll and proceeding with unification based on that. However, on this day, he changed his stance and decided to accept Candidate Kim Sang-uk's proposal. (김상욱 후보와 김종훈 후보는 지난 23∼24일 단일화 여론조사를 진행하고 24일 경선 결과를 발표할 예정이었다. 하지만 김상욱 후보가 돌연 국민의힘 지지자의 개입 정황이 있다며 경선 여론조사를 중단해 단일화가 파행 위기에 접어들었다. 김상욱 후보는 27∼28일 이틀간 역선택 방지 조항을 넣어 새롭게 여론조사 경선을 진행하자고 제안했고 김종훈 후보는 기존에 진행한 여론조사 결과를 발표하고 그를 토대로 단일화 해야 한다고 주장해왔다. 하지만 이날 입장을 바꿔 김상욱 후보의 제안을 받아들이기로 했다.)

With the Progressive Party's acceptance of a re-run, the primary for the Ulsan mayoral candidate unification between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party is set to proceed over the course of one day, on the 28th. (진보당의 재경선 수용으로, 민주당과 진보당 사이 울산시장 후보 단일화 경선은 28일 하루동안 진행될 예정이다.)

item.title: President Lee and First Lady Visit Busan Market Again… "Selling Sea Squirts?" (이 대통령 부부, 또 부산 시장행…“멍게 파시나요?”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung visited Busan's Namhang Market on the 27th, engaging with citizens and merchants. Following their visit to Busan's Jagalchi Market the previous day, they continued the trend by stopping by the market after the Sea Day event. (이재명 대통령 부부가 27일 부산 남항시장을 찾아 시민·상인들과 소통했다. 전날 부산 자갈치시장 방문에 이어 이날도 바다의 날 행사를 마치고 시장을 찾은 것이다.)

Chief Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung reported in a written briefing that the presidential couple toured the market, guided by the merchant association president. President Lee showed interest in a grandmother selling seafood, remarking, "It seems you sell sea squirts here." First Lady Kim Hye-kyung bought some sea squirts and asked, "Can I eat them as is?" When the grandmother replied, "They're from the sea, so you need to wash them 3 to 4 times," Kim nodded with a smile. <<> The presidential couple shook hands and greeted citizens at the market. One citizen, upon seeing the president, said, "I'm so happy, I've got goosebumps." When a citizen holding a dog greeted them warmly, President Lee even cradled the dog for a group photo. Another citizen they encountered remarked, "I've lived here for 60 years, but this is the first time a president has visited." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 이 대통령 부부가 상인회장의 안내를 받으며 남항시장 곳곳을 둘러봤다고 전했다. 이 대통령은 해산물을 파는 할머니에게 “여기서는 멍게를 파시나 봐요”라고 관심을 표했고, 김혜경 여사는 멍게를 구매하며 “그냥 먹어도 되느냐”고 물었다. 할머니가 “바닷물이라 3~4번은 씻어야 한다”고 하자 김 여사는 웃으며 고개를 끄덕이기도 했다.)

The couple stopped by a clothing store and a fruit and vegetable shop, purchasing blueberries using Onnuri gift certificates. When buying a bag of onions, President Lee asked, "This year's onion harvest is abundant, so aren't prices much cheaper?" The merchant replied, "It's actually so cheap that it's a concern." (이 대통령 부부는 시장을 찾은 시민들과 악수를 하며 인사를 나눴다. 한 시민은 대통령을 보고 “반가워서 소름이 끼친다”고 했다. 강아지를 안고 있던 시민이 이 대통령 부부에게 반갑게 인사하자, 이 대통령은 강아지를 안고 함께 사진을 찍기도 했다. 시장에서 마주친 한 시민은 “이곳에서 60년을 살았는데 대통령이 온 것은 처음”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, the presidential couple crouched down by an elderly vendor selling dandelions at a stall and asked, "How much for a basket?" Upon hearing "3,000 won," they bought 5,000 won worth. When First Lady Kim asked the elderly vendor about a recipe for dandelions, President Lee smiled and said, "You can just eat them raw," prompting nearby citizens to burst into laughter. (이 대통령 부부는 의류 매장과 과일·채소가게 등을 들렀고, 온누리상품권으로 블루베리 등을 구매했다. 이 대통령은 양파 한 봉지를 구매하며 “올해 양파 풍작이라 가격이 많이 싸지 않느냐”고 물었고, 상인은 “안 그래도 너무 싸서 걱정”이라고 답했다.)

The presidential couple and their aides had lunch at a restaurant in the market, enjoying sliced raw fish and stew. First Lady Kim brought out sujeonggwa (cinnamon punch) and mini gimbap she had purchased at the market, offering them to the aides. The merchant association president who joined them for the meal mentioned that business had become harder than before due to a declining population, expressing a wish for the market to attract more foreign tourists. Chief Secretary Kang reported that President Lee empathized with those sentiments. (또 이 대통령 부부는 좌판에서 민들레를 팔고 있던 한 어르신 앞에 쪼그리고 앉아 “한 바구니에 얼마냐”고 물었고, “3천원”이라고 답하자 5천원어치를 구매했다. 김 여사가 어르신에게 민들레 조리법을 물어보자 이 대통령이 웃으며 “그냥 생으로 먹어도 된다”고 말해 주변에 모여 있던 시민들이 웃음을 터뜨리기도 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Busan BTS Concert Accommodation Price Gouging Must Be Addressed...List of Offenders Should Be Published" (이 대통령 “부산 BTS 공연, 숙박비 바가지 개선해야…명단 공개도”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 27th, "Trying to overcharge for accommodation ends up being a nuisance to the entire neighborhood," adding, "It would be good to publish a list of such businesses." This was a critique of the controversy over price gouging that has arisen in some areas. (이재명 대통령이 27일 “숙박비 더 받아보려고 하다가 온 동네 민폐(가 된다)”라며 “그런 업체들은 명단 공개, 이런 것 좀 하면 좋겠다”라고 말했다. 일부 지역에서 빚어진 바가지요금 논란을 비판한 것이다.)

President Lee made these remarks at a preparatory meeting for the 48th World Heritage Committee held at BEXCO in Busan, saying, "Busan's image is deteriorating due to the so-called accommodation price gouging controversy related to the BTS concert, and this needs to be improved." This comes ahead of a June concert by the idol group BTS in Busan, which sparked controversy as lodging prices soared. He urged that such issues must not occur during the World Heritage Committee meeting to be held in Busan in July. ( 이 대통령은 이날 부산 벡스코에서 열린 제48차 세계유산위원회 준비현황 보고회에서 “부산이 비티에스 공연 관련한 소위 숙박비 바가지 (논란) 때문에 이미지가 안 좋아지고 있는데 개선해야 할 것 같다”라며 이렇게 말했다. 부산은 아이돌 그룹 방탄소년단(BTS)의 6월 공연을 앞두고 숙박 요금이 치솟아 논란이 됐는데, 7월 부산에서 개최되는 세계유산위원회에서는 이런 문제가 벌어져선 안 된다고 당부한 것이다. )

President Lee said, "If tourists come and are overcharged or treated rudely, once a video goes up on YouTube, the image is ruined in an instant," adding, "It takes a tremendous amount of time to recover. Trying to make a quick buck leads to a fatal blow." ( 이 대통령은 “관광객들 좀 온다 싶으면 바가지 씌우거나 불친절하거나 해서 유튜브 영상 한번 올라가면 순식간에 (이미지가) 망가진다”라며 “다시 살아나는 데 엄청 (시간이) 걸린다. 푼돈 좀 벌어보려다가 치명타를 입는다”고 했다. )

President Lee clarified, "People aren't angry because the accommodation prices are high," but rather "because they make a reservation, get it cancelled, and then it's sold to someone else at a higher price—that's what makes them angry." He continued, "Such places need to face very severe sanctions," adding, "It's not about criticizing them for charging high prices." While he acknowledged that rising demand can naturally increase prices, he emphasized that unilaterally cancelling existing reservations to excessively increase accommodation fees is problematic. Some lodging establishments in Busan are under suspicion of cancelling prior reservations and reselling them at higher prices. <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam: wu32@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 “사람들이 (숙박요금을) 비싸게 받아서 화나는 것이 아니다”라며 “예약을 했는데 취소를 당하고, 다른 사람한테 비싸게 팔아먹고 이러니 화가 나는 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “그런 데는 제재가 아주 심하게 돼야 한다”라며 “비싸게 받는다고 뭐라 그러는 건 아니다”라고 덧붙였다. 수요가 몰려 가격이 오르는 것까지 막을 순 없지만, 숙박비 요금을 과도하게 높여 받기 위해 기존 예약까지 일방적으로 취소하는 것은 문제라고 한 것이다. 부산의 일부 숙박업체들은 기존 예약을 취소하고 높은 가격에 이를 재판매했다는 의혹을 받고 있다. )

item.title: People Power Party Gyeyang-eul Candidate, During Conversation with Jeon Han-gil about Martial Law, Says “History Will Be Reassessed” (국힘 계양을 후보, 전한길과 계엄 대화 중 “역사 재평가될 것”)
item.description:
Sim Wang-seop, the People Power Party candidate for the by-election for Incheon Gyeyang-eul National Assembly seat, said “There will come a day when history is reassessed” when the December 3 emergency martial law was mentioned during a conversation with far-right YouTuber Jeon Han-gil. This remark can be interpreted as suggesting that the assessment of the December 3 emergency martial law, which the court recognized as an insurrection, could change. <<> According to a video uploaded on the YouTube channel of independent candidate Kim Hyun-tae, who is also running in the same district on the 25th, the day before, Jeon happened to encounter Sim while visiting Jiseonsa Temple in Incheon Gyeyang-gu with Kim on Buddha's Birthday, and the two began a conversation. <<> During the conversation, when Sim said he was asked during the election period “who the main enemy is” and replied “ask the person you should ask,” Jeon said, “Do you know what the Democratic Party says? They say the main enemy is the insurrectionary forces. The insurrectionary forces. Aren't they crazy? They are the real insurrection.” In response, Sim said, “That history will have a day to be reassessed, I think so.” Then, when Jeon chimed in with “The truth will come out,” Sim replied, “Yes.” <<> When Jeon then said, “I never imagined I would see the current president (former President Yoon Seok-yeol) being called the ringleader of an insurrection,” and covered his head, Sim smiled and lightly placed his right hand on Jeon's arm. At this point, Sim said nothing further, and the video included the subtitle “Candidate Sim Wang-seop offering encouragement.” <<> On February 19, the first trial court sentenced former President Yoon, who was charged with leading an insurrection, to life imprisonment. The court ruled that Yoon’s deployment of military forces to the National Assembly to paralyze its functions constituted “an insurrection with the aim of subverting the constitutional order.” <<> Earlier, on the 1st, the People Power Party’s nomination committee decided to unilaterally recommend Sim as the candidate for Incheon Gyeyang-eul. The committee reportedly selected Sim, a businessman, citing his ties to the local community. The Democratic Party candidate for the same district is Kim Nam-joon, a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung and former spokesperson for the Blue House. <<> Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (심왕섭 국민의힘 인천 계양을 국회의원 보궐선거 후보가 극우 유튜버 전한길씨와 대화를 나누다 12·3 비상계엄이 언급되자 “역사는 재평가될 날이 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 법원이 내란으로 인정한 12·3 비상계엄에 대한 평가가 달라질 수 있다는 취지로 읽힐 수 있는 발언이다.)

item.title: Park Min-shik: "Park Geun-hye's 30-Year Sentence Demand Shows Fake Conservatism"... Han Dong-hoon: "Why Blame Me for What Yoon Seok-youl Did?" (박민식 “박근혜 30년 구형, 가짜 보수”…한동훈 “윤석열이 한 걸 왜 내게”)
item.description:
Regarding former President Park Geun-hye's visit to Busan, Park Min-shik of the People Power Party and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, both running in the Busan North Gap by-election, engaged in a sharp verbal clash on the 27th. After visiting Jinju in South Gyeongsang Province and Ulsan, former President Park was scheduled to visit Busan's Gijang Market to campaign for Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate in the Busan mayoral election. (박근혜 전 대통령의 부산 방문을 놓고 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 나온 박민식 국민의힘과 한동훈 무소속 후보가 27일 날선 신경전을 벌였다. 이날 경남 진주와 울산을 들른 박 전 대통령은 부산시장 선거에 출마한 박형준 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세를 하기 위해 부산 기장시장을 방문할 예정이다.)

Park Min-shik, who planned to accompany her on this schedule, posted on Facebook that day, targeting Han: "It's pathetic how someone who demanded a 30-year sentence for President Park Geun-hye, pretending to be a conservative, is trying to steal the People Power Party's name," adding, "Independent Han Dong-hoon winning and splitting the conservatives—that's exactly what the Democratic Party wants, and it only helps Lee Jae-myung's government run amok." (이 일정에 동행하기로 한 박 후보는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 한 후보를 향해 “박근혜 대통령에게 30년을 구형하고 가짜 보수인 주제에 국민의힘 이름을 훔쳐쓰려고 하는 게 딱하다”며 “무소속 한동훈이 (당선)되어 보수가 분열하는 것, 바로 그것이 민주당이 진짜 바라는 일이고, 이재명 정부의 폭주만 도와주는 꼴”이라고 말했다.)

Later that day, Han met with reporters at a campaign rally in Busan's Deokcheon Station and said of former President Park's visit to Busan, "She thinks and judges things in her own way, so I respect that," and "I admire her life so far." He then targeted Park Min-shik, saying, "This person, who worked to make President Yoon Seok-youl—who decided on demanding a 30-year sentence—president, took a minister position, and is now doing a 'Yoon encore,' is blaming me for the 30 years that Yoon demanded." (한 후보는 이날 오후 부산 덕천역 유세현장에서 기자들과 만나 박 전 대통령의 부산 방문에 대해 “여러가지 생각을 하고 판단하시는 것이기 때문에 존중한다”며 “박 전 대통령의 그 동안의 삶을 존경한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 박 후보를 향해 “‘30년 구형’을 결정했던 윤석열 대통령을 대통령으로 만들기 위해 나서고 장관 자리를 하고 지금까지 윤어게인 하고 있는 사람이, 지금 윤 대통령이 구형한 30년을 저한테 뒤집어 씌우고 있다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, Han had posted on Facebook: "A vote for Park Min-shik isn't just a wasted vote—it's a vote helping Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and a vote helping Lee Jae-myung's runaway government," urging "citizens of North Gap to 'unite' behind the conservative candidate, Han Dong-hoon." (앞서, 한 후보는 페이스북에 “박 후보를 찍는 표는 단순한 사표가 아니라 민주당 하정우 후보를 돕는 표이자 이재명 정권 폭주를 돕는 표”라며 “북구갑 시민들이 보수 후보인 한동훈으로 ‘단일화’해 달라”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Park Geun-hye over Jang Dong-hyuk'... From Jinju to Ulsan, People Power Party 'Campaign Committee Chair-Level' Schedule (‘장동혁보다 박근혜’…진주 찍고 울산까지, 국힘 ‘선대위원장급’ 일정)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye visited Ulsan on the 27th and stated, "Ulsan is the result of my father's efforts to build a prosperous nation." With one week left until the June 3 local elections, she toured the Yeongnam region all day, offering full support to People Power Party candidates. (박근혜 전 대통령이 27일 울산을 찾아 “울산은 아버지께서 잘사는 나라를 만들기 위해 노력한 결과물”이라고 말했다. 박 전 대통령은 6·3 지방선거를 일주일 앞두고 이날 온종일 영남권을 순회하며 국민의힘 후보들을 총력 지원했다.)

During her visit to Sinjeong Market in Ulsan's Nam-gu district, former President Park said, "What I always feel when coming to Ulsan is that Ulsan truly is the product of my father's efforts to create a prosperous country." This is interpreted as an attempt to rally the conservative base by highlighting the Park Chung-hee administration's role in leading Ulsan's industrialization and invoking the 'symbol of conservatism,' former President Park Chung-hee. (박 전 대통령은 이날 울산 남구 신정시장을 찾아 “울산에 올 때마다 느끼는 것은 울산이야말로 아버지께서 잘사는 나라를 만들기 위해서 노력하신 결과물이라는 생각”이라고 말했다. 박정희 정권이 울산의 산업화를 이끌었다고 강조하며 ‘보수의 상징’인 박정희 전 대통령을 언급해 지지층을 결집하려는 것으로 풀이된다.)

Former President Park remarked, "The duty of politicians is to strive so that the people can live happily and prosperously," adding, "It's about acting on one's words with conviction." She continued, "I believe that Mayor candidate Kim Doo-gyeom (Ulsan) and National Assembly candidate Kim Tae-gyu (Ulsan Nam-gu Gap), who are here with us today, will faithfully uphold their promises based on that conviction. I hope Ulsan citizens will show them strong support." (박 전 대통령은 “국민이 행복하게 잘 살아갈 수 있도록 노력하는 것이 정치인이 할 일”이라며 “신념을 가지고 언행을 실천하는 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “여기 자리에 함께하신 김두겸 (울산)시장 후보, 김태규 (울산 남갑) 국회의원 후보, 이 두 분은 앞으로 그런 신념을 바탕으로 약속한 것을 잘 지켜나갈 분이라고 믿고 있다. 울산 시민들이 많이 지지를 보내줬으면 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier that day, former President Park also campaigned in Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province, supporting Gyeongnam Governor candidate Park Wan-soo and Jinju Mayor candidate Han Kyung-ho. At the Central Market in Daean-dong, Jinju, she said, "People say the economy is tough these days. I'm worried too." She added, "The candidates here today, Park Wan-soo and Mayor candidate Han Kyung-ho, are both economic experts. I trust they will revive this struggling economy." She further stated, "If you trust and entrust them, I believe they will revitalize the economy. I sincerely hope for good results." (박 전 대통령은 이에 앞서 경남 진주에서도 박완수 경남지사 후보와 한경호 진주시장 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령은 경남 진주 대안동에 있는 중앙시장에서 “요즘 경제가 어렵다고들 한다. 저도 걱정하고 있다”며 “오늘 함께하신 박완수 후보 그리고 한경호 시장 후보 두 분은 모두 경제전문가다. 어려운 경제를 잘 살려내리라고 믿는다”고 말했다. 또 “믿고 맡기시면 경제를 살릴 것이라고 믿는다. 부디 좋은 결과 있기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Addressing the crowd that gathered at the market, former President Park said, "I came to Central Market last year as well. You welcomed me warmly then, and today I'm so grateful to see so many of you greeting me again." (박 전 대통령은 시장에 몰려온 시민들을 향해 “작년에도 중앙시장에 왔었다. 그때도 환대해주셨는데, 오늘도 이렇게 많은 분이 맞아주셔서 너무 감사하다”고도 했다.)

Former President Park spent about 20 minutes each touring Jinju Central Market and Ulsan Sinjeong Market, greeting citizens. People who gathered to see her repeatedly chanted "Park Geun-hye." Surrounded by layers of security guards, Park moved through the market, which was packed with citizens. She waved cheerfully at the crowd and even gave high-fives to citizens reaching out between her security guards. (박 전 대통령은 이날 진주 중앙시장과  울산 신정시장을 약 20분씩 돌며 시민들에게 인사를 건넸다. 박 전 대통령을 보기 위해 모인 시민들은 연신 “박근혜”를 연호했다. 시장을 가득 메운 시민들 사이로 박 전 대통령은 경호원들에게 겹겹이 둘러싸인 채 시장을 누볐다. 박 전 대통령은 밝은 표정으로 시민들을 향해 손을 흔들었고, 경호원들의 팔 사이로 손을 내미는 시민들에게 하이파이브를 해주기도 했다.)

Former President Park has recently been fulfilling a schedule equivalent to that of the People Power Party's 'election committee chair.' After visiting Daegu on the 23rd and Chungcheong and Daejeon on the 25th, she covered the Yeongnam region on the 27th and is scheduled to visit Gangwon on the 28th. (박 전 대통령은 최근 국민의힘 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 일정을 소화하고 있다. 박 전 대통령은 앞서 지난 23일 대구, 25일 충청과 대전을 방문한 데 이어 이날 영남권을 훑었고, 28일에는 강원을 찾을 예정이다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Government: "Projectile that attacked the NAMUHO similar to Iranian turbojet engine" ([속보] 정부 “나무호 공격 비행체, 이란산 터보제트 엔진과 유사”)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 27th that, after analyzing the wreckage of the projectile that struck the HMM NAMUHO in the Strait of Hormuz, "the engine was similar to an Iranian turbojet engine, and markings presumed to be from an Iranian manufacturer were confirmed on the parts." (외교부가 호르무즈해협에서 피격당한 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호를 친 비행체 잔해물을 분석한 결과 “엔진은 이란산 터보제트 엔진과 유사했고, 부품에서 이란의 제조사 각인으로 추정된 것이 확인됐다”고 27일 밝혔다.)

First Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Park Yoon-joo stated in a ministry briefing that day, "The government will summon the Iranian ambassador to South Korea to explain the investigation results, convey a strong protest regarding the attack on our vessel, and demand responsible measures, including prevention of recurrence." (박윤주 외교부 1차관은 이날 외교부 브리핑에서 “정부는 주한 이란대사를 초치해 조사 결과를 설명하고, 우리 선박 피격에 대한 강력한 항의 뜻을 전달하면서 재발방지를 포함한 책임있는 조치를 요구할 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Jeong-cheol: "The Two Giants Use the Seoul Mayor Position as a Stepping Stone to the Presidency... It's Time for a Third Party to Step Up" (김정철 “거대 양당에 서울시장은 대권 발판…제 3당이 나서야 할 때”)
item.description:
"In a two-party structure where we must choose between red or blue, I ask that you select a third option that represents rational common sense and the silent majority." (“빨간색 아니면 파란색을 선택해야 하는 거대 양당 구조 속에 합리적인 상식과 조용한 다수를 대변하는 제3의 선택지를 선택해달라.”)

In a phone interview with The Hankyoreh on the 27th, Kim Jeong-cheol, the Reform Party candidate for Seoul mayor in the June 3 local elections, emphasized, "Seoul has stagnated. Political and administrative reform cannot be achieved through traditional political methods. It is time for a third party to step up." (6·3 지방선거 김정철 개혁신당 서울시장 후보는 27일 한겨레와의 전화 인터뷰에서 “서울은 정체되어 있다. 기존 정치권 방식으로는 정치·행정 개혁이 이뤄질 수 없다. 제3당이 나서야 할 때”라고 강조했다.)

—Why does a third party need to step up? (―3당이 나서야 하는 이유는?)

"The two major parties have used the Seoul mayor position as a stepping stone for the next presidential election to operate city governance. They are inevitably forced to present pledges based on political interests rather than substantive ones. I have no political debts. I can make decisions that candidates from the two major parties cannot, such as reducing support for government-affiliated organizations. I will allocate that budget more to civic groups and citizens in blind spots." (“거대 양당은 서울시장직을 차기 대권을 위한 발판처럼 활용하며 시정을 운영해왔다. 또 실질적인 공약보다 정치적 이해관계에 따른 공약을 내놓을 수밖에 없는 구조다. 저는 정치적으로 빚진 것이 없다. 거대 양당 후보들이 하지 못하는, 관변단체 지원 축소 같은 결단도 할 수 있다. 그 예산을 시민단체와 사각지대에 놓인 시민들에게 더 많이 배분하겠다.”)

—What is your main pledge? (―대표 공약은?)

"Administrative innovation based on artificial intelligence (AI). I will build a Seoul-specific AI system so that citizens can automatically receive information on welfare services they need without having to visit in person. Within six months of taking office, I can replace various application processes of Seoul city with an AI system." (“인공지능(AI) 기반 행정 혁신이다. 서울시만의 에이아이 시스템을 구축해 시민들이 직접 찾지 않아도, 개인에게 필요한 복지 서비스를 자동으로 안내받을 수 있도록 하겠다. 취임 즉시 6개월 이내에 서울시의 각종 신청 행정을 에이아이 시스템으로 대체할 수 있다.”)

—What about pledges related to real estate, a major issue in Seoul? (―서울 최대 현안인 부동산 관련 공약은?)

"I will ease regulations to supply at least 50,000 and up to 100,000 housing units for single- and two-person households, focusing on areas near subway stations. I will also build a system to accelerate redevelopment and reconstruction to expand supply. For example, there are many lawsuits over contribution fees in project processes, but I will provide advance guidance on expected contribution fees through simulations from the early stages of project implementation. This way, I believe we can reduce the current redevelopment and reconstruction period of 15 to 20 years to about 7 years." (“규제를 완화해 역세권 중심으로 1∼2인 가구용 주택을 최소 5만호에서 최대 10만호까지 공급하겠다. 또 재개발·재건축 속도를 높일 수 있는 시스템을 구축해 공급을 확대하겠다. 예를 들어 사업 과정에서 분담금 관련 소송이 많은데, 사업 시행 초기부터 시뮬레이션을 통해 예상 분담금을 미리 안내하는 방식이다. 이렇게 하면 기존 15∼20년 걸리던 재개발·재건축 기간을 7년 수준으로 줄일 수 있다고 본다.”)

—What is your strength? (―본인의 강점은?)

"I have no judicial risks or criminal records. Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, is an unverified and flawed product. Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, has failed to show results during his four terms as Seoul mayor. As a lawyer, I have experience solving nearly impossible problems, such as in the so-called 'Lime Incident' financial fraud case. I am someone who can get things done. I will work solely for the citizens of Seoul." (“전 사법 리스크도, 전과도 없다. 정원오 더불어민주당 후보는 검증되지 않은 부실 상품이다. 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 서울시장 4선 동안 성과를 보여주지 못했다. 저는 변호사 시절 금융 피해 사건인 이른바 ‘라임 사태’에서도 불가능에 가까웠던 문제를 풀어낸 경험이 있다. 일을 해낼 수 있는 사람이다. 오직 서울시민만을 위해 일하겠다.”)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong: sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Visits Busan Markets for Second Consecutive Day, People Power Party Protests "Stop Election Interference" (연이틀 부산 시장 방문 이 대통령 향해, 국힘 “선거개입 멈춰라” 반발)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Busan for the second straight day, engaging with citizens. The People Power Party opposed it, calling it election interference. (이재명 대통령이 이틀 연속 부산을 찾아 시민들과 소통했다. 국민의힘은 선거 개입이라고 반발했다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Kang Yoo-jung reported on the 27th via a written briefing that the President and First Lady toured Namhang Market in Yeongdo-gu on that day. The presidential couple purchased blueberries and onions using Onnuri gift certificates, and had lunch of raw fish and soup at a restaurant inside the market with their aides. The previous day, the President and First Lady also visited Jagalchi Market in Jung-gu, a traditional market representing Busan, for dinner. ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 27일 서면 브리핑을 통해 이 대통령 부부가 이날 영도구 남항시장 곳곳을 둘러봤다고 전했다. 이 대통령 부부는 온누리상품권으로 블루베리, 양파 등을 구매하고, 참모진과 시장 안에 있는 식당에서 점심으로 회와 탕을 먹었다. 이 대통령 부부는 전날에도 부산을 대표하는 전통시장인 중구 자갈치시장을 찾아 저녁 식사를 했다.)

The President has been frequently visiting markets after handling regional schedules recently. On the 23rd, he stopped by Oedong Traditional Market in Gimhae on the occasion of attending a memorial service for former President Roh Moo-hyun in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province. On the 13th, he visited Nammok Maseong Market in Dong-gu, Ulsan, and on the 14th, Moran Folk 5-Day Market in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. On the 15th, after visiting the site of the planned Daegu-Gyeongbuk integrated new airport, he participated in a rice-planting event in Gunwi County, Daegu, and on the 19th, he visited his hometown of Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, for the Korea-Japan summit. Coincidentally, areas like South Gyeongsang Province, Ulsan, and Daegu are considered battlegrounds in the upcoming local elections. <<> The People Power Party countered, demanding "Stop illegal election interference." Song Eon-seok, co-chair of the People Power Party's joint election campaign committee, posted on Facebook: "No matter how urgent the election is, is it normal for a president to have a cheerful raw fish party at Jagalchi Market after a tragic accident involving the collapse of the Seosomun overpass in Seoul that killed three citizens?" He added, "How can the president, who bears ultimate responsibility for national safety, be so absorbed in the election?" <<> Meanwhile, President Lee is scheduled to hold a press conference marking his first year in office on June 8 at the State Guest House in the presidential office. <<> Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr Jang Na-rae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 최근 지역 일정을 소화한 뒤 시장을 자주 방문하고 있다. 지난 23일에는 노무현 전 대통령 추도식 참석차 경남 김해시를 찾은 것을 계기로 김해 외동전통시장에 들렀다. 지난 13일에는 울산 동구 남목마성시장, 14일에는 경기 성남시 모란민속5일장을 찾았다. 또 15일에는 대구·경북 통합 신공항 건설 예정 부지 현장을 찾은 길에 대구 군위군에서 모내기 행사에 참여했고, 19일에는 한-일 정상회담차 고향인 경북 안동을 방문했다. 공교롭게도 경남과 울산, 대구 등은 이번 지방선거 접전지로 꼽힌다.)
